title: Copper | Thirdway
description: Thirdway partners with owners, occupiers, and professional teams to create world-class spaces.

main.className: container mb-10 flex flex-col text-center text-pretty xl:mb-16
relative m-2 aspect-377/361 overflow-hidden rounded-xs lg:m-4 lg:aspect-1408/792

main: With cryptocurrency firm Copper, our challenge was to transform an architectural vision into tangible reality, leaving an incredible mark in the back streets of Soho.
Breaking away from London’s financial district, Copper challenged banking design conventions with their new space in Soho — the Richard Rogers-designed Broadwick House.

main.className: aspect-[16/9] relative mx-2 overflow-hidden rounded-xs lg:mx-4 lg:aspect-[1408/792]

main: Ambitious design calls for harmonious collaboration. The client had their own incumbent contractors for security, furniture, lighting (to name a few), whilst our contractors specialised in MEP and logistics. Working as the glue binding these elements together, we ensured that every detail was carefully planned and executed. We like to think of it as orchestrating a symphony of talent, each contributing their expertise.

main.className: aspect-[16/9] relative mx-2 overflow-hidden rounded-xs lg:mx-4 lg:aspect-[1408/792]

main: Innovation was woven into the fabric of Copper. From timed blinds to specialised lighting systems, every technical solution was carefully crafted with precision and foresight from our team, elevating the building beyond mere construction to a true work of art.

The Sixth and Seventh floors are entirely dedicated to hosting clients, featuring a statement marble bar and banquet-style seating, all capitalising on Broadwick House’s panoramic views of the city. The functional layout allows for seamless interaction between the Copper team and their clients in a comfortable ‘member’s club’ aesthetic.

main.className: aspect-[16/9] relative mx-2 overflow-hidden rounded-xs lg:mx-4 lg:aspect-[1408/792]

main: Copper’s new HQ is a legacy of craftsmanship, collaboration and unwavering dedication to excellence in its gleaming copper façade and meticulously crafted interiors.
